title: Resume Clinic: out-of-graph review, chat-revise, and {{green:deterministic export}}
headSub: ADR-066/068. Job-agnostic, runs only on user request. The Fidelity Reviewer runs on every rewrite; the chat loop revises edited_json turn by turn; export is a pure renderer with no agent call.

takeaway.text: Every rewrite is fidelity-checked and every edit is the human's; export is a {{green:pure renderer}} (md/txt/html/json/docx/pdf), so the materialized resume is exactly the approved text - never re-authored by a model.
